title: Server finder
features:
⚡ Server Finder
Server Finder helps you quickly locate the best game servers based on region, server type, and ping. Easily browse available regions, check real-time latency, search for specific countries, and instantly teleport to your selected server for a smoother gaming experience.
✨ Features
🌍 Region Selection
👥 Server Type Filter
🔄 Real-Time Region & Ping Refresh
🔍 Country Search
📡 Live Ping Display
🟢 Low & High Ping Indicators
✨ New Server Detection
🚀 One-Click Teleport to Selected Region
🎨 Clean & Modern User Interface
📱 Mobile & PC Friendly
Designed to help players find faster, more stable servers with lower latency and better overall performance.
